meta.description: Filesmith is a free, offline app for Windows and Mac. Compress videos for Discord, convert iPhone photos, merge and sign PDFs. Nothing is uploaded.

home.title: Filesmith: fix any file, privately

home.lead: Compress videos for Discord, turn iPhone photos into JPGs, merge and sign PDFs. Filesmith does it on your own computer. Free, no account, no limits.

home.demo_placeholder: What do you want to do?

proof.l: A 40-second 4K clip, compressed to fit Discord's 10 MB limit
A PNG screenshot saved as a JPG that looks the same
Uploaded to the internet. Every job runs on your computer.

home.privacy_p: Online converters make you upload contracts, ID scans and private photos to servers you know nothing about. Filesmith has no servers. It can't see your files, because they never leave your computer.

facts.d: Every job runs locally, with FFmpeg, pdf-lib and PDF.js.
Download it and use it. Nothing to sign up for.
No analytics in the app or on this website.
All the code is public, so anyone can check it.

home.final_p: Free, with no trial and no watermark. About 110 to 135 MB.

video.name: Video
video.blurb: Pick a size limit and Filesmith lands just under it, every time.
items: Compress to a size
8, 10, 16, 25 or 50 MB, or your own number. Long videos drop resolution so they still look clean.
Compress by quality
High, balanced or smallest, when the size doesn't matter.
Trim
Drag two handles on a live preview and keep only the part you want.
Make a GIF
Pick a few seconds, choose smoothness and width.
Extract audio
Save the sound of any video as an MP3.
Convert to MP4
MOV, MKV, WEBM and AVI become MP4, which plays everywhere.
Remove sound
Keep the picture exactly as it is and drop the audio.

images.name: Images
images.blurb: iPhone photos that won't open on Windows, fixed in bulk.
items: Convert
HEIC, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP and TIFF to JPG, PNG or WebP.
Resize
By longest side or percentage. Photos are never stretched.
Compress
Smaller files that look the same, ready to email or upload.
Images to PDF
Each image becomes a page, turned the right way up.

pdf.name: PDF
pdf.blurb: The PDF jobs you'd normally pay for, or upload your documents for.
items: Sign and fill
Draw or type a signature, add names and dates, and drag them into place.
Merge
Combine PDFs in any order.
Split
Every page, by ranges, or just the pages you pick.
Organize pages
Reorder, rotate and delete pages by dragging thumbnails.
Compress
Light keeps text selectable. Strong shrinks scans and photo-heavy files.

audio.name: Audio
audio.blurb: Voice notes, podcasts, songs and ringtones.
items: Convert
MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC and OGG.
Trim
Cut a ringtone or the good part of a voice note, with a preview.
Even out volume
Quiet recordings get louder and loud ones softer, to the level streaming apps use.

features.title: Features
features.lead: Eighteen tools for video, images, PDF and audio. Each one is a plain choice like “under 10 MB” or “to JPG”, never a page of settings.
everywhere: Drag files anywhere onto the window. Filesmith sorts videos, photos, PDFs and audio for you.
Press Ctrl K (⌘K on Mac) and type what you want, like “heic to jpg”.
Hundreds of files in one go, with progress for each one.
Every result is a new file. Your originals are never changed.
Each result shows its size before and after.
Dark by default, with light mode or your system's setting in Settings.

download.title: Download
download.lead: Free, with no account. Pick your computer.
download.which_mac: Not sure which Mac you have? Open the Apple menu, then About This Mac. “Apple M1”, M2, M3 or M4 means Apple Silicon.
download.first_p: Filesmith is new and isn't signed with a paid developer certificate yet, so your computer shows a warning the first time. This is how to open it safely.
first_win: If you see “Windows protected your PC”, click More info.
Click Run anyway. You only do this once.
first_mac: Open the .dmg and drag Filesmith into Applications.
Right-click Filesmith in Applications and choose Open.
Click Open. If macOS still blocks it, go to System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click Open Anyway.
download.verify_p: Compare these SHA-256 fingerprints with your file to make sure it hasn't been tampered with.
download.source: Prefer to build it yourself? The source code is on GitHub.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.short: The short version: Filesmith collects nothing. Your files never leave your computer.
sections: Filesmith processes every file on your own computer. It makes no network requests, has no account and no analytics, and sends no crash reports. Your settings and the list of files you've made are stored in a file on your computer, and you can clear the history in the app at any time.

This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may keep standard server logs, such as IP addresses, under its own privacy policy. The site sets no cookies and uses no analytics or tracking. Fonts are hosted here, not loaded from Google. Your language choice is remembered in your browser only.
If you leave a tip on Ko-fi, Ko-fi handles the payment under its own privacy policy. Filesmith never sees your payment details.
Questions about privacy? Open an issue on GitHub.

faq.title: FAQ
items: Is Filesmith really free?
Yes. There's no trial, no limit and no watermark. It's open source. If you'd like to support it, there's a tip jar, but you never need to use it.
Is it safe?
Filesmith only reads the files you give it and saves new copies next to them. It never changes or deletes your originals and never connects to the internet. All of the code is public on GitHub.
Why does my computer warn me when I open it?

Windows and macOS warn about apps that aren't signed with a paid developer certificate, which costs about $100 to $300 a year. Filesmith is new and made by one person, so it isn't signed yet. The download page shows how to open it.
Which files can it open?
Video: MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI and more. Images: HEIC, JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF. PDF. Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, WMA.
How does “under 10 MB” always land under 10 MB?

Filesmith measures the video's length, works out exactly how much data fits in your limit, then encodes twice: once to study the video and once to spend the data where it matters. Long videos drop to a lower resolution so they still look clean.
Does it work without the internet?
Yes. Filesmith never needs the internet, not even to start.
Who made this?
Elvis Zygmanta, under the name Hollowbit. See the About page.

about.title: About
about.lead: I'm Elvis Zygmanta. I build software under the name Hollowbit: small, free tools that do one job well and treat the people using them with respect.
why: Shrinking a video for Discord, opening an iPhone photo on Windows, signing a PDF: almost everyone has to do these things. The usual answer is a website that wants you to upload your files, wait in a queue and pay to remove a watermark.
That felt wrong for jobs a normal computer can do in seconds. So I built Filesmith: one app for video, images, PDF and audio that runs entirely on your own computer.
I designed it, wrote the code, built the installers for Windows and Mac, made this website, and wrote 21 automated tests that drive the real app to check every tool works.
rules: Not in the app, not on the website.
You shouldn't need to sign up to convert a file.
No analytics and no data collection.
Every line of code is public.
tech: One codebase for Windows and Mac
Lands just under a target file size
21 end-to-end tests on the real app

support.title: Support
support.help_p: Found a bug or something not working? Open an issue on GitHub. Say which computer you're on, which version of Filesmith, and what you tried.
support.give_p: Filesmith is free and stays free. A tip helps pay for the code-signing certificates that make the security warnings go away.
